data.one_liner: A Dart implementation of the libp2p networking stack for peer-to-peer applications.
data.what_it_does: Provides a modular networking stack supporting multiple transports like TCP and UDX, Noise security protocol, stream multiplexing via Yamux, and peer discovery. It enables building decentralized peer-to-peer applications and protocols in Dart.
use_when: You are building a peer-to-peer application in Dart or Flutter.
You need encrypted and authenticated connections using the Noise protocol.
You require customizable transport layers like TCP or UDX.
avoid_when: You only need a simple client to talk to a traditional REST, GraphQL, or WebSocket backend.
You require built-in QUIC transport support.
strengths: Modular architecture with pluggable transports, security, and multiplexers.
Built-in NAT traversal tools including hole punching and relay support.
Comprehensive suite of core libp2p protocols and event systems.
weaknesses: Does not support the QUIC transport protocol.
Some advanced integration tests and features require external tools or separate packages.
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency to pubspec.yaml and configure transports, security, and options in code when initializing the Libp2p host.
